notes: The booklet has no per-step parts boxes with Element IDs, so the part-to-step mapping is inferred from the step pictures and the inventory page; several assignments are best guesses.
Inventory IDs not in the catalogue were added as new types; their port lists are simplified.

Piece counts: 4222960 x2 (the two orange rear lights), 4542673 x2 (roll-bar beacons), 4211185 x1 (one crate, which holds the plunger, dynamite and pickaxe and sits in the truck bed). Black A-pillar caps and black door slopes are placed as 4211525 and 4504382.

The remaining count check (4211413 page 2, 4211525 page 12) is not a real discrepancy. The extracted text of the parts page prints '1x 4211413 / 6x 4211525' twice, from a layered duplicate. The printed parts page shows each entry once: 4211413 x1 and 4211525 x6. The graph therefore keeps 1 and 6 (4 grey round plates in the rock, 2 black pillar caps).
Port reuse: catalogue parts with a single stud.1 / anti-stud.1 port carry several joins. Only the first join names the port; the others use a null port.

Wheels: the catalogue's wheel-holder pins are 'ball' kind, which does not pair with the rim's pin-hole kind, even with null ports. The wheel-to-holder link is therefore a revolute contact edge (rim spinning on the holder pin, retained by friction) rather than a joined edge. The wheel copies attach to b32 (front axle, copies 1-2) and b33 (rear axle, copies 3-4) via overrides.
Dynamite clip join and sign pole-to-base join use a null port on one side because the catalogue port kinds (clip/clip, stud/stud) are not pairable.
'9566' is a booklet label, not a real element ID. The catalogue entry lego-seat-stand-blue (booklet label 9566) is used for the blue seat with steering wheel.
4261117 (unclear in the pictures) is treated as a jackhammer/drill held by the minifig; 4289538 is the sign pole clipped to the warning triangle.
The two 3003941 pink plates: one under the roof (step 22), the other on the bed back wall (steps 18-19) by guess.
Cab details (4113206 brackets, 4171666 panels, 4537985 / 4190511 door pieces, 4597902 hood) are placed from small pictures; exact stud mapping is approximate.

The booklet builds several small models (minifig, warning sign, plunger, clock and dynamite, rock with crystals) alongside the truck. They are linked into one graph by contact edges: minifig seated in the cab, items resting in the crate, the crate in the truck bed, the rock standing beside the truck.
